comparison.objective: Candidate sets a gripper opening stop, locks the adjustment, and verifies retained motion; PR-2188 installs a case fan into a tool-less bracket.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial driver seating plus wrench countertorque on a coupled screw/jam nut; PR-2188 requires square fan alignment, guided lowering, and pressing through two spring latches.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades 90° adjustment accuracy, seated/retained nuts, three repeatable cycles, drift, and tool clearance; PR-2188 grades fan insertion, both hooks snapped over it, release, and one-second stability.
comparison.reason: Snap-fitting a separate fan does not test preserving an adjustable setting during locknut reaction or verifying that setting through repeated articulated cycles; no material comparison rubric detail is missing.
